login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: We email you a one-time link. No password.
login.sent: Check your inbox. The link works once and expires in 24 hours.
login.error: Could not send the link. Check the address and try again.
home.allDone: Everything is done for now. We will message you when the next step is ready.
home.empty.title: Your workspace is not ready yet
home.empty.body: Once your payment is confirmed, your checklist appears here. This usually takes under a minute.
home.error.title: We could not load your checklist
home.error.body: Nothing is lost. Refresh the page, or contact us if it keeps happening.
task.stub.title: This step is coming soon
task.stub.body: We are still building this screen. Your delivery lead will guide you in the meantime.
layers.label: Progress: {done} of 3 stages complete
intake.title: Guided intake
intake.saveError: Could not save. We will retry.
intake.missing: Please answer the required questions, or mark them as not sure.
intake.done.title: Intake complete
intake.done.body: Thank you. Your delivery lead has everything needed for kickoff.
intake.fieldRequired: This question needs an answer, or tick “I am not sure”.
access.title: Access and assets
access.subtitle: Everything we need to run your system, in one place.
access.noPasswords: Never send passwords by email or chat. Anything you add here is encrypted, and every time it is viewed we keep a record.
access.secretHint: Write-only: once saved, nobody can read it back here.
access.linkInvalid: Enter a full web address starting with https://
access.dropHint: Images or PDF, up to 200 MB each.
access.fileType: {name} is not an image or PDF.
access.flagged: This has been blocked for over 72 hours, so our team has been alerted and will reach out.
review.title: Deliverables
review.list.empty: No deliverables yet. We will publish the first one here for you to review.
review.viewingOld: You are viewing an older version. Switch to the latest to approve.
review.commentHint: Select any text to comment on that exact line.
review.orphaned: The quoted text changed in this version.
review.approveBody: Approving locks this version, so this text will not change. {unlock}
review.changesPlaceholder: Tell us in a sentence or two
review.approvedBy: Approved by {name} on {date}. This version is locked.
review.changesRequested: You asked for changes. We will send a new version.
review.locked: Locked. Comments are closed on an approved version.
review.diff.same: No changes between these two versions.
review.preview.none: A LinkedIn preview is available for profile and post deliverables.
payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: You never pay ahead of the work. Each invoice appears only after you approve its stage.
payments.methods: Card or SEPA direct debit. VAT is added at checkout where it applies.
payments.reminder: We will remind you in {n} days.
payments.overdueNote: This invoice is overdue. Paying keeps your next stage on schedule.
payments.monthlyBody: Starts automatically after stage 3 is paid: {amount} per month. You can cancel any time before it starts.
payments.demoPay: Demo only: in the live app this opens the secure payment page.
